claim_steps: Apply at https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/startups/ with details about your business.
Meet eligibility: at least one developer, a working website, officially incorporated, under 10 years old.
Keep product and company details updated in the member portal to remain eligible for benefits.

social_proof.text: Access free cloud credits from NVIDIA and partners for more flexible, scalable development and deployment. Inception is free — no application fees, membership fees, or equity requirements, and no deadlines or cohorts.
social_proof.title: Inception Program for Startups | NVIDIA

social_proof.author: Ksenia Moskalenko
social_proof.text: OPPORTUNITY: @nvidia will give your AI startup free training, cloud credits, and VC intros. No VC funding required, no equity, no deadline. NVIDIA Inception program: technical courses, SDKs, cloud credits from NVIDIA & partners, preferred hardware pricing, Capital Connect investor exposure. Rolling applications.

summary: NVIDIA Inception is a free, rolling startup program with no fees, equity, deadlines, or cohorts: free cloud credits from NVIDIA and partners, technical training, preferred hardware pricing, and VC exposure via Capital Connect.
